name: Mysterious Youth
source:
A mysterious young man who is always covered with a cloak and a hat.
Because he is on good terms with [url=/c41644]Michiru[/url] it seems he's opening his heart a little.

[spoiler]He is actually [url=/c21317]Mict's[/url] older brother, Sact, whom Mict has been searching and became a Tenshi in order find to him.[/spoiler]
